messages:
lee: quick sync re: GPU postmortem follow-ups. we tracked 5 remediation items: tenant surge policy, scheduler hysteresis, nightly maintenance gating, minimum headroom reserve, and fallback telemetry + customer notif. need owners + dates.

anya: i'll take tenant surge policy (per-tenant "surge_guard" with 10% elastic cushion for 90s + 6m cooldown). will write RFC + unit tests by 2026-04-07.

lee: thanks. short-term goal: get config + runbook change in within 2 weeks; medium-term: integrate with routing for degraded model.

Tomas: i'll own scheduler hysteresis tuning and replay measurements. plan: run baseline replay, then test coalesce=110ms and hysteresis=5%. target metrics: eviction_rate, requeue_delay_ms, p99_latency. measurement report due 2026-03-29; PR within 12 business days.

kyle: i'll draft headroom reserve proposal: static 3% + ephemeral 7% surge buffer drained over 8 minutes. i'll include cost impact and alert thresholds. draft by 2026-03-31.

status-bot: Created issue infra/ops#1791 "surge_guard + scheduler-hysteresis" (assignee: anya).

anya: gating nightly jobs note: propose a job-runner preflight that checks global_headroom_pct; if <11% delay job by random 2-5m. will coordinate with batch team. gating PR target 2026-04-02.

Tomas: measurement hypothesis: coalesce=110ms reduces simultaneous evictions by ~40% in synthetic bursts; expect p99 increase <6%. will attach replay graphs to the issue.

lee: telemetry & comms: we need an event_id for every fallback, write to tenant_usage (field: fallback_event_id) and send automated short-notice to tenant-owners when fallback occurs with ETA for mitigation. who can own the notif template?

kyle: i'll add the telemetry fields to the headroom PR and include the notif template in the runbook.

anya: calendar: "GPU capacity remediation triage" weekly 20m starting 2026-03-26 09:30 PDT. rotating infra oncall. invite sent.

status-bot: Reminder: issue infra/ops#1791 assigned to anya - due 2026-04-07.

Tomas: testing plan summary: replay scenarios = baseline, surge_guard-only, surge_guard+coalesce=110ms. pass criteria: eviction_rate down >=35%, p99 delta <=7%. results due 2026-03-29.

lee: final ask: add a short incident-pattern query to the dashboard that surfaces nightly spikes and the overlap of heavy jobs. can someone add a Grafana panel?

anya: i'll add the panel and the alert that fires when 03:00-04:00 UTC avg headroom < 9% for 3 intervals.

kyle: once PRs land i'll consolidate cost numbers and a customer-facing note. mira from support suggested we include an "incident FAQ" link in tenant notices.

lee: perfect. i'll update the incident ticket with owners, deadlines and this thread summary. weekly triage for 6 weeks then reduce cadence if stable. ping here with PR links. :white_check_mark:
